metrics.stage_localization_accuracy: mean(stage equals expected_stage; null equals null for registered valid scenarios)
metrics.contract_identification_accuracy: mean(contract_id equals expected_contract_id; null equals null for registered valid scenarios)
metrics.component_localization_accuracy: mean(component_id equals expected_component_id; null equals null for registered valid scenarios)
metrics.false_certification_rate: mean(expected violation and not recertified and (pipeline_status VALID or action ACCEPT))
metrics.evidence_completeness: mean of seven-field completeness: observed, expected, source URI, stage, component, contract, observation SHA256; no-violation rows are not-applicable complete
metrics.repair_success: among five registered repair scenarios, repair executed and target contract repaired
metrics.full_recertification_success: among five registered repair scenarios, full recertification true
metrics.runtime_ms: mode decision time only; excludes pipeline execution, Docker startup and MLflow UI

statistics.correction: Holm across preregistered main comparison tests
